summary: An NSE index in Quote mode: the frame carries LTP, OHLC and the previous close, no change (mStock's web adapter sends none), and of the order-flow fields only those the packet fills with a value; its zeros are left out.

deviations.reason: mStock's Quote packet (123 bytes) carries no open interest; the web sends oi 0 for it (mstock_adapter.py:369, quote_data.get('oi', 0) over the parser's oi: 0 placeholder, mstockwebsocket.py:211), an invented zero a client reads as a real OI. The desktop leaves oi out until a packet has carried one, and then sends the last OI the instrument's full packet carried on this connection (feed/bridge/snapshot.rs merges by presence), never a 0 it was not sent.
deviations.ref: decisions 2026-11-09: web zeros for values the stream did not send are left out; web openalgo#2376

deviations.reason: mStock's index Quote packet fills the last quantity, average price and book totals with 0 (its fixed 123-byte layout; an index has no trades of its own), and this web adapter sends those zeros for an index (mstock_adapter.py:362-375). The docs say a value the stream does not carry is left out; the desktop leaves them out (lead rule 2026-11-09, approved: a 0-filled index field stays left out, a non-zero one is sent).
